quest.title: Return of the Jade Chamber?
quest.description: You learn from a Millelith named Kun that there are plans to rebuild the previously destroyed Jade Chamber and that some small preparations to that end are already taking place...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x50000, Teachings of Prosperity x2, Teachings of Diligence x2, Teachings of Gold x2

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Hi. Would you like to buy anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'd like a copy of "Meadow of Gems."

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: "Meadow of Gems"? We don't have it in stock here. Do you need it in a hurry?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, they're rebuilding the Jade Chamber...

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Are they really? Well, that would require proper preparation, yes. Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: Perhaps you can look for Qingzhou instead. He is extremely well-read — perhaps he might know where a copy of "Meadow of Gems" might be found.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Jifang
dialogues.text: If my memory serves, Qingzhou often lodges at the Wangshu Inn. You can try looking for him there.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: A conundrum. Most vexing, indeed...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, uh, do you know anything about the "Meadow of Gems"?

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: The "Meadow of Gems," you say? Yes, I do recall that book.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: I once went hither and thither in search of material with which to write a poem about merchants and happened upon this book in the process.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: I did not fully comprehend the book's contents, but some of its anecdotes proved most inspirational nonetheless.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Let me try to recall the name of that poem. Pray, give me a moment...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you remember where I can find that book?

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Ah, so you wish to locate that book? I must confess that no such place comes to mind...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: However, if you need it urgently, I could just write you out a copy of it myself.

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: Ah, it was hardly a lengthy text. Memorizing it was no tall order.

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: More to the point, the book collector wouldn't let me loan it out.

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: And since poetry is not something that one can rush, I decided I'd simply write out a copy for my continued perusal... The book's contents were not very long, either, so I have it more or less memorized now.

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: Ah, it is but a trifling matter, my liege. Still, perhaps you could do me a favor in exchange for the hand-written text.

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: As embarrassing as this is... I have been so focused on gathering inspiration here that only now do I realize: I have completely forgotten to eat today. Suddenly, I feel rather ravenous.

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: Could you help me get a serving of Triple-Layered Consommé? In exchange, I shall write you a copy of "Meadow of Gems."

response.speaker: Qingzhou
response.text: I believe that I should just about be done by the time you return.

talks.objective: Give a serving of Delicious Triple-Layered Consommé to Qingzhou

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: The "Meadow of Gems," how does it start... Ah yes, "Commerce and trade, like springs and streams, begin with the mountains and end with the seas..."

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: "This grand plan charts the course that will lead us, slowly but surely, to Liyue's longevity and the people's prosperity."

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Ah, you've returned. One moment, I am still penning the last few lines...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Hmm... There. That should do it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's your Triple-Layered Consommé...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Ah! That can wait, though — first, please see if the book is to your satisfaction. I trust that you will find my penmanship to be quite satisfactory.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is seriously impressive work...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Hahaha, you praise me excessively, my liege. This book is for you. Don't lose it, now.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Hmm? Do you need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to order some small ornaments made of bamboo...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Small bamboo ornaments, you say? I could do it, but may I know where this order is coming from?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's from this checklist of Baiwen's...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Oho... an order from Yuehai Pavilion, is it? Well then, I suppose I should complete it as quickly as I can, then.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: There is one problem, though: the bamboo forest that I frequently gather materials from has suddenly become occupied by a great many boars, for reasons unknown to me.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Though it is not much of a problem, I often have to go around them to collect bamboo...

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: If you could chase those boars out, I can go and collect some bamboo now, and we can begin work right away.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: I shall wait for you here, then. Once you have chased those boars out, come back and give me a shout.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: So, have you chased those boars away?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All of 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: That will do. I shall head over to collect bamboo in a while. Once the ornaments are ready, I shall have them delivered directly to Yuehai Pavilion.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: This order is quite large. There's quite the sum to be made here...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Hello, can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about those preparations you've been making...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: This is... the "Meadow of Gems"? Where did you get this book? I've searched high and low throughout Liyue, and I couldn't find it even so...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Qingzhou hand-wrote a copy for me.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: That poet? Hmm, it seems that his reputation is well-founded...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Thank you for your help in preparing these objects. Once Master Lu sends those ornaments over, I will also arrange for him to receive appropriate compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, you're rebuilding the Jade Chamber, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Indeed, we do have plans to do so. But with the number of things we will need to prepare, there is still much work to be done. I doubt that we can finish rebuilding it quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Not to mention our biggest material headache, which we have yet to find a solution to...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Never mind, I shall not speak of it. Thanks for your help once again — and please, accept these for your aid. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must return to my work.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Hmm, small bamboo ornaments...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: "There are those who lose their jobs and have no reliable source of food, nor a roof over their heads, they toil in vain in their barren fields. All the while, the wealthy merchants' residences overflow with gold and jade. What justice and uprightness is this?"

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Though this passage still speaks of the mercantile way, it reveals quite a fair amount more meaning upon closer reading...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Hello, can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here about those items you needed...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: This is... the "Meadow of Gems"? Where did you get this book? I've searched high and low throughout Liyue, and I couldn't find it even so...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Qingzhou hand-wrote a copy for me.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: That poet? Hmm, it seems that his reputation is well-founded...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Thank you for your help in preparing these objects. Once Master Lu sends those ornaments over, I will also arrange for him to receive appropriate compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help once again — and please, accept these for your aid.
